anchor_value: USD-denominated fair value column shown with dollar signs in the source schedule

culprit_citations.quoted_text: Red Griffin TopCo, LLC | Common Stock | 1,746 | 8,435 | 1,598

findings.detail: The Red Griffin TopCo, LLC fair value was extracted with fair_value_currency U_CAD even though the source schedule presents the fair value column as dollar-denominated.
The Firebird Co-Invest L.P. fair value was extracted with fair_value_currency U_JPY even though the source schedule presents the fair value column as dollar-denominated.

rationale: FX02 is a Class 1 row-level currency check. The flagged extracted fair_value_currency values are U_CAD and U_JPY, but the matching raw schedule rows sit under the Fair Value column of table 38, whose first populated dollar row and total row show dollar signs for the cost and fair value monetary columns. The source therefore supports USD-denominated fair values, making the non-USD extracted currencies real localized data errors.
